candidate.text_basis:
请为乙醇（中性、单重态、气相）生成结构，在当前资源和预算内自行选择合适的方法和基组并说明依据，完成几何优化和该优化结构上的振动频率计算。交付初始结构、收敛后的全部9个原子坐标（注明Å）、完整27项频率和模式编号（注明cm^-1，保留平移/转动项），解释是否能支持局部极小值结论。保留原始输入、输出、脚本和失败尝试，分别说明执行、科学检查和验证缺项。不要把程序正常结束当成优化收敛或极小值确认；若预算内不能完成，准确说明未完成部分。

若结构生成、搜索或其他算法使用随机数，请统一采用种子 1701 并在报告中记录；若某一库或模型不支持固定种子，明确记为不可固定，不伪造确定性。

method.reason: Model-based choice without literature retrieval: B3LYP is a well-established hybrid DFT functional for organic-molecule geometries and harmonic frequencies. A D3(BJ) dispersion correction will be specified as an explicit input modifier; it is not being represented as part of the method identity. This is a resource-conscious choice for ethanol under the available 4-core/192 MB-per-process budget.

basis.reason: Model-based choice without literature retrieval: def2-SVP is a compact, consistently defined polarized double-zeta basis suitable for ethanol geometry optimization and a 27-mode harmonic frequency calculation within the stated resource budget. It gives an explicit, reproducible basis rather than relying on an implicit composite-method default.
